title: No inserted carrier correction legalizes a PR5718-shape leak class on the PR6030 P104 word (no new κ)
body:
## Result (scoped exact result, no new κ)

This takes step (3) that #6040 released: output corrections at later meetings for the PR5718-shape leak classes. It runs on the #6030 word (κ .003125804; selected at main `721c03822` during this session, inputs unchanged) and on the #5907 word. The package is `research/p104-pr5718-leak-correction`.

| Word | Leak classes | Carrier sources | Legalized by an inserted carrier correction |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| PR6030 | 4,033 | 0 | 0 |
| PR5907 | 4,206 | 0 | 0 |

- **The non-z part decides.** In the split word each field holds `orig_f + β_f (z − ℓ)`, where `ℓ = row_p(i)·X` is the retired value. So the defect outside `V` is the rank-one `d_O ⊗ (z − ℓ)`, not just the z-leak `d_O`. A correction from a pure multiple of the new helper (#6040's suggested `r += q·new`) only adds multiples of `z`. It therefore cannot clear the defect, with any number of corrections. The z-part alone is easy: in a local full run on #6030 it passes in 2,071 of 4,033 classes.
- **A single correction needs a carrier.** For one inserted chart-local ADD/SCALE to clear the defect, its source must be a *carrier*: zero in the original word but carrying the cut content (`β ≠ 0`). Any program built only from carrier sources needs a first carrier in the uncorrected word.
- **No carrier exists.** On both words, no field at any event after any cut is a carrier, in any leak class. So every leak class is excluded for single corrections and for carrier-only programs.
- **Positive control.** On the PR5713 word, a carrier and a leak planted after PR5718's own cut are found. An independent simulator (`check.py`) accepts the found correction with no defect outside `V`, and rejects a perturbed coefficient.

## Verification

```sh
python3.12 -B research/p104-pr5718-leak-correction/verify.py           # ~90 s, PASS_P104_PR5718_LEAK_CORRECTION
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-pr5718-leak-correction
```

All of these passed locally on macOS with Python 3.12: normal, `-I -O`, `--check-only` and the registered replay. CI was not watched.

## Scope and remaining obligations

- **Not excluded:** several corrections from non-carrier sources whose rank-one terms combine to the defect. This includes combination carriers: several ADDs into one target. A direct rank test was too slow and is not shipped; it is the first open question in the README.
- **Also not covered:** rewritten events, new MOVEs, and injections other than unit injection.
- This is a scalar condition at the level of #5994/#6040. Native maps, owned lifetimes, caller, compiler, precision and outer checks are not involved.
- The selected record is unchanged. These are agent checks, not human acceptance.
